meta.title: Privacy policy — Daniel Rassomakhin
meta.description: What data Daniel Rassomakhin's portfolio site collects, why, and how to control it: the contact form, and Yandex Metrica and Google Analytics only with your consent.

title: Privacy policy
lead: This is my personal portfolio site. Here, briefly and in plain words, is what data it collects, why, and how you can control it. I do not sell data or share it with anyone but the services named below.

owner.title: Who handles the data
owner.text: Daniel Rassomakhin, the owner of this site. For anything about your data, write to me directly:

data.title: What is collected
data.text: Only what I need to answer you and to see what people find interesting here:
data.note: I do not ask for or collect passport or payment details, phone numbers or other sensitive information.

what.label: What
what.text: Your name, a contact to reply to (email or Telegram), your message and the technologies you picked.

why.label: Why
why.text: To reply to you and talk about your project. Nothing else: no mailing lists.

how.label: How
how.text: The request goes to a Yandex Cloud function (servers in Russia), which forwards it straight to my Telegram through a bot. The function itself stores nothing. Telegram is run by a foreign company, so the form's data leaves Russia.

keep.label: How long
keep.text: It stays in our conversation while we talk, and is deleted if you ask.

basis.label: Basis
basis.text: Your consent: you give it with a separate checkbox before sending, and can withdraw it at any time by writing to me.

analytics.title: Analytics and cookies
analytics.text: The site uses Yandex Metrica and Google Analytics so I can see which projects people look at and where they leave. Until you allow analytics, their scripts do not load at all and no cookies are set.

what.label: What
what.text: Pages and navigation, clicks and scrolling, time on the site, where you came from, device and browser type, approximate location from the IP address. Metrica also records sessions (Webvisor): how the cursor moves and what gets clicked. What you type into the form is not recorded.

who.label: Who
who.text: Yandex Metrica — Yandex LLC, Russia. Google Analytics — Google LLC, USA: this data leaves Russia.

cookies.label: Cookies
cookies.text: _ym_uid, _ym_d and other _ym* — Yandex Metrica, up to 1 year. _ga and _ga_* — Google Analytics, up to 2 years.

basis.label: Basis
basis.text: Your consent in the note at the bottom of the page. The answer is kept for half a year, then the site asks again.

change.label: Change it
change.text: With the switch below or the cookie icon in the bottom right corner. Turning analytics off deletes the counters' cookies and reloads the page.

browser.title: What is stored in your browser
browser.text: Two entries in localStorage. They are not cookies: they are never sent anywhere and only let the site remember your choices. Clearing the site's data in your browser settings removes them.
browser.items:
consent:analytics — your answer about analytics and when you gave it;
graphics:choice — whether the light graphics mode is on.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.text: The site is hosted on Yandex Cloud, with servers in Russia. Like any web server, the host receives the technical details of a request (IP address, browser, time) in order to serve the page. I do not collect or analyse them. Fonts and images load from this site itself, with no third-party services.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can find out what data of yours I have, ask me to correct or delete it, and withdraw your consent. Write to the email or Telegram in the first section — I will reply within 10 working days. If you believe your rights have been violated, you can complain to Roskomnadzor, the Russian data protection authority.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: If anything in this policy changes, the date at the top of the page will change too. The current version is always here.
